Climb the word ladder!

Change one letter to make the next word. But which letter? You decide!

dog ➜ bog ➜ bug ➜ jug
For grown-ups: Each new word is built from the last one. She taps the letter she wants to change, then taps the new letter (either order works). The 🔊 button says the next word. Sounding it out slowly helps her hear which sound changed. 👀 Show word writes the word for her to match, which makes it easier. After two misses, a yellow box gives a clue. Vowels are red.
